decision: token material in the tenant's EU Durable Object, AES-GCM under a per-tenant key derived (HKDF) from a key-encryption key held read-only in the Secrets Store, with a key id; AAD tenant|provider|kind
why: a Worker cannot write per-tenant Secrets Store secrets without an account-level Cloudflare token; decided by the founder through the strategy thread (1A)
evidence: connections.test.ts: sealed per tenant, provider and kind

decision: Okta: a key pair per tenant, private key sealed in the tenant, the admin registers the public JWK and grants scopes in their Okta; Vanta and Drata pasted, sealed, rotation due in 90 days
why: no consent redirect exists for these; decided through the strategy thread (2A)
evidence: connections.test.ts: Okta assertion verifies; pasted secrets and the report

decision: a rotated refresh token is committed with its access token in one transaction before use; a failed write raises; a refused refresh revokes
evidence: connections.test.ts: failed write, no retry, then revoked

decision: consent state is a one-time nonce in the tenant's object, expiring in 10 minutes, bound to the provider; the callback's state names the tenant and only that object can redeem it; the object fixes its tenant name on first use
why: a forged or replayed callback must not attach a credential to any tenant
evidence: connections.test.ts; local Worker: forged callback refused

decision: the scope manifest builds the authorize request; a test checks they match; Google scopes read-only, no domain-wide delegation
why: the consent screen is the security review answer

decision: revocation fails closed: a 401 or 403 revokes the connection, the read is partial, scenarios unresolved, and the brief names the source and since when; unused 14 days and rotation due are reported
why: the customer's admin can cut access at any time and Crowbo must say so
evidence: connections.test.ts: 401 revokes, billing unresolved, brief names Okta

decision: FetchJson.page has a real transport: Link rel="next" followed only on the same host; host-pinned, capped bodies
why: live Okta reads can now be complete
evidence: connections.test.ts: two Link pages complete; cross-host next incomplete

decision: KEK rotation: a new key id made current, rekey per tenant moves every secret, then the old key is removed; material under the old key opens during rotation
evidence: connections.test.ts: rotation and rekey; docs/CONNECTIONS.md runbook

decision: the connect routes on a local Worker: start returns an authorize URL with PKCE and a tenant-bound state; no ingestor role gets 403; a forged callback is refused; Okta setup returns a public key with no private part; a pasted Drata key gets a rotation date; status shows no secrets
why: the routes run in the Durable Object, not only in tests
evidence: wrangler dev, staging env, throwaway keys

decision: scheduled live reads through connections arrive with the dress rehearsal (PR 2); provider endpoint and scope details are verified: false until then; the decision latency measurement is deferred to after the sandboxes and a confirmed staging deploy
